To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the smart grid is the next generation of the electric power grid that will be built with a variety of new technologies that will allow the grid to become more efficient, reliable and sustainable.

the smart grid is a new paradigm that will require the integration of a diverse set of technologies and the education of engineers to understand the interrelationships between the technologies and the grid.

the smart grid is the integration of a variety of technologies into the electric power grid to allow for two-way communication and control between the utility and the end-user, and that this integration requires an understanding of the power grid and the various enabling technologies.

the following questions.
the integration of smart grid technologies into electrical engineering curriculum, with an emphasis on developing a course to introduce smart grid concepts to electrical engineering students.
the development of an undergraduate and graduate course that will help students understand the integration of smart grid technologies into the electrical power grid.

the smart grid course is a very useful and important course for electrical engineering students and professionals.

we have designed a smart grid class to be used as a senior elective/ graduate level course for the ECE program at the University of Arkansas and have developed a set of laboratory experiments that can be used to help demonstrate the concepts of the smart grid.
we have developed a course to help students understand the smart grid and how it will impact our society.

a smart grid curriculum is possible to develop and integrate within the current engineering curriculum.
